name: Midheaven
defines: Your public direction: career, reputation and what you are known for.

signs.aries: You are recognised as someone who moves first, your ambition is impatient, and you would rather lead a small thing than follow a large one.
signs.taurus: What you are aiming at is security and something solid to show for the years, and people read you as unhurried and hard to shift.
signs.gemini: Your direction changes as your interests do, and at a distance you are taken for clever, current and impossible to pin to one thing.
signs.cancer: You are heading towards something you can look after, and strangers register you as approachable before they register you as capable.
signs.leo: You are aiming at recognition and will not pretend otherwise, and you appear confident from across a room whether or not you feel it.
signs.virgo: Your ambition is to be genuinely good at it rather than celebrated for it, and you give an impression of precision and slight reserve.
signs.libra: You are heading towards something civilised and shared, and the impression you leave is polished, even-handed and easy to deal with.
signs.scorpio: Your aims are not advertised, and people sense there is more to you than the position you occupy, which there is.
signs.sagittarius: You are aiming at somewhere larger than where you started, and you come across as frank, curious and faintly ungovernable.
signs.capricorn: Your ambition is long-range and structural, and you are taken for a serious person some years before you have earned it.
signs.aquarius: You are heading somewhere nobody has quite mapped, and you give off independence, principle and a distinct resistance to being recruited.
signs.pisces: Your direction is felt rather than planned, and the impression you leave from a distance is gentle, elusive and difficult to summarise.
